text: {"fault_id": "FAULT_06", "physical_reasoning": "The evidence shows a simultaneous decrease in A_Feed_Stream1 (XMEAS_1) and A_Feed_Flow (XMV_44) with a 223% deviation, while Stripper_Steam_Valve (XMV_50) increases and Stripper_Steam_Flow (XMEAS_19) rises.
